text: The Board confirms that it had received two separate proposals from CVC Advisers Limited and Veritas Capital Fund IX, L.P. PUSU deadline is 2 September 2026
Extension of PUSU deadline to 2 September 2026
Receipt of regulatory approvals. The scheme remains subject to Court Sanction and is expected to become effective on 20 August 2026
Shareholders representing approx. 18.13% of Union Jack's share capital confirm that they will not accept the offer (up from 14.09% as of 31 July 2026)
Scheme is approved by the Court and General meetings. Completion is expected on 13 August 2026
